Shader Graphs/sg_emission_FlickerDepth.note: Lit UV maps; emission colour*map*4 Overlay-flickers with sin(time*_FlickerSpeed)*_MaskPower*map.a; clip z += _Shifter.

Shader Graphs/sg_emission_flicker_fogswi.note: Lit UV maps; emission colour*map*4 Overlay-flickers with sin(time*_FlickerSpeed)*_MaskPower*map.a; _USEFOG keyword toggles fog.

Shader Graphs/sg_fresnel.note: Lit UV maps; emission = lerp(_FresnelColor, _FresnelEdgeColor, pow(1-N.V, _FresnelIntensity)) + emission map*colour*5.

Shader Graphs/sg_vertex_shader_opaque_no.note: Object-XY simple-noise vertex inflation scrolled by time; Lit UV maps with optional fresnel rim emission; no fog.

Shader Graphs/sg_vertex_shader_trancepar.note: World-XY simple-noise vertex inflation; premultiplied transparent Lit with fresnel rim emission, alpha = fresnel + albedo.a.

Shader Graphs/sg_burnt_ground.note: Unlit alpha-blended ground decal; scrolling simple-noise embers * flicker mask * pulsing _FlickerColor added; no fog.
